questions.title: Who will win the Golden Boot at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
questions.background: The Golden Boot recognizes the World Cup's leading goal scorer, with FIFA's tie-breaking rules determining the winner if players finish level on goals.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : FIFA's official announcement of the 2026 World Cup Golden Boot winner. Resolution Date : Resolve upon confirmation of the award winner at the conclusion of the tournament, whose final is scheduled for July 19, 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the player officially awarded the Golden Boot, rather than the Silver Boot or Bronze Boot.

questions.title: Which country will win the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup?
questions.background: The 2026 men's FIFA World Cup will be co-hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : FIFA's official final match result and announcement of the tournament champion. Resolution : Resolve to the country whose national team wins the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup final, scheduled for July 19, 2026. A victory after extra time or a penalty shootout counts as winning the final. Accepted Answer Format : The country's common English name.

questions.title: Which player will win the Golden Ball at the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup?
questions.background: The Golden Ball is awarded to the player judged the best performer at the FIFA World Cup.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : FIFA's official announcement of the 2026 men's World Cup tournament awards. Resolution : Resolve to the player officially awarded the Golden Ball at the conclusion of the tournament, whose final is scheduled for July 19, 2026. This is the tournament-wide award, not an individual match award. Accepted Answer Format : The player's name or established professional name.

local_articles.title: Messi's World Cup brilliance hailed by Emile Heskey
local_articles.snippet: SINGAPORE – At the 2006 World Cup in Germany, an 18-year-old Lionel Messi gave the world a glimpse of what was to come. Coming off the bench against Serbia and Montenegro, the tournament debutant scored and provided an assist in Argentina’s 6-0 rout, offering the first flashes of a brilliance that would define an era. Two decades on, Messi is still commanding football’s biggest stage. Now 39 and playing in his sixth World Cup, he continues to captivate fans and fellow professionals.
